completeOperativeContract.name: Contraption Crafter

originalObject.name: Contraption Crafter
originalObject.description: Racial feat tied to Gnome heritage.
originalObject.effect: Construct and deploy a temporary gadget with random utility (1/day).

completeOperativeContract.additionalUniversalAcquisitionGate: One actual unspent class-scheduled ASI/feat opportunity or separately authorized feat grant; prerequisite success never creates a choice.
completeOperativeContract.completeOperativeProcedure: Require actual Gnome heritage. NEW once per24 elapsed hours, spend10 uninterrupted minutes with actual usable tinkers tools and5gp of suitable owned mundane parts; commit the use and parts at construction start. The feat grants construction permission with these tools but no general tool proficiency. On completion roll1d4 openly on the four complete profiles below; no choice, reroll, duplicate product or refund for an unwanted result. One active feat gadget at a time; beginning a new legal construction ends the old gadget. Interrupted work loses the committed parts/use and yields no working gadget. The Tiny mundane object is1lb, AC10, HP1, has no creature turn/actions, and stops after1hour from completion or destruction. Place it in a reachable legal space or activate it with the profile's Action; moving/holding uses actual hands/object rules. Ownership can pass with the real object; its expiry/remaining uses travel with it and never reset. At expiry/dismantling it becomes inert spent parts with no reusable credited crafting value; no purchased tool/supply/consumable is replenished. Explicitly NEW economics, not a claim that original source named a price. It does not inherit Tinker Gnome's separate four clockwork profiles,10gp reclaim or maintenance loop, and creates no Tinker class device/attack/companion.
completeOperativeContract.requirementsStatus: Source-derived finite validation contract; actual positive/negative actor histories still require testing.
completeOperativeContract.sourceDecision: Adopt four NEW1lb/AC10/HP1/hour-life gadget profiles with actual5gp materials and10-minute work; separate from Tinker Gnome ancestry and43 crafted devices.

completeProfiles.name: Shaded lamp
completeProfiles.procedure: Action light or extinguish the integral enclosed wick. While lit it gives bright light10ft and dim light another10ft for the remaining gadget lifetime. No fuel inventory, attack, ignition of other objects, magical darkness penetration or restored illumination item is created.

completeProfiles.name: Line bell
completeProfiles.procedure: Action fix the gadget and its attached5ft non-load-bearing thread across one reachable ground passage. An actual body crossing and physically touching the taut thread rings an ordinary bell audible30ft, then the thread releases and the device becomes inert. It neither detects incorporeal/noncontact passage nor reveals identity/location beyond its physical site, restrains, trips or causes damage. A visible thread can be noticed by ordinary senses; it has no automatic hidden DC.

completeProfiles.name: Light clamp
completeProfiles.procedure: Action attach/remove the clamp to a reachable mundane edge no more than2inches thick. It can hold one unattended or willingly presented object of at most5lb against that edge, falling normally on expiry/destruction. It cannot restrain a creature, secure a door against forced entry, support a climber, substitute for restraints or improve a check. No free hand is created.

completeProfiles.name: Hand fan
completeProfiles.procedure: Action crank while held to move ordinary air through a5ft cone until the start of your next regular turn; sustained use needs anotherAction. It can cool a touched/hands-reach surface for comfort and stir loose paper/dust, without mechanical damage, creature movement, suffocation relief, weather/hazard immunity or removal of a rules-defined gas/cloud. It can visibly show ordinary airflow but identifies no substance.

limits: Source-qualified synthetic Gnome ancestry/ability/Warrior progression and actual paid feat opportunity; not a full character build or authenticated campaign.

Tools, parts ownership/value/access, uninterrupted activity, turn receipts, hearing/contact, object presentation and unobstructed five-foot reach are conditional fixture facts. No inventory or physics engine authenticates them.
Open d4 faces are supplied outcome witnesses; the model rejects choice/reroll/repeated completion but does not provide an RNG or verify an externally rolled die.
The construction milestone is explicitly scheduled at ten minutes. Interruption events must be supplied when work/access fails; this is not an activity monitor.
Ordinary resolved object damage is supplied; attacks, defenses and full object-damage resolution are not re-executed.
Clamp release preserves a required ordinary-fall event. Its trajectory, impact damage and broader support/geometry remain separate.
Dismantling is an explicitly supplied authorized physical event; its ordinary action/time procedure is not invented here.
Fan user regular-start timing is exercised in initiative. Full virtual-marker and outside-initiative clock integration, line of sound/light occlusion and complete hand/cargo systems remain separate.
No full acquisition audit, all-FXC04 closure, complete feat execution, actual GPT verdict, runtime promotion, human balance, publication or cosmology approval is claimed.
